# REQ: LANG-691 LANG-692 LANG-693 LANG-694 BEGIN { FS = "," count = 0 } # Lines with a number in the second field. $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { total += $2 count++ names[NR] = toupper($1) } /error/ && NF > 3 { print "bad line", NR > "/dev/stderr" } function avg(sum, n) { return n > 0 ? sum / n : 0 } END { printf "count=%d avg=%.2f\n", count, avg(total, count) for (i in names) delete names[i] }
